title: Cold Response Transcriptome Analysis of the Alternative Splicing Events Induced by the Cold Stress in D. catenatum.
authors: Zheng, Yan; Luo, Landi; Chen, Qian; Yang, Danni; Gong, Yuqiang; Yang, Ya; Qin, Xiangshi; Wang, Yuhua; Kong, Xiangxiang; Yang, Yongping
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA-Seq分析冷胁迫下铁皮石斛的差异表达基因和可变剪接事件，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dendrobium catenatum Lindl is a valuable medicinal herb and gardening plant due to its ornamental value and special medical value. Low temperature is a major bottleneck restricting D. catenatum expansion towards the north, which influences the quality and yield of D. catenatum. In this study, we analysed the cold response of D. catenatum by RNA-Seq. A total of 4302 differentially expressed genes were detected under cold stress, which were mainly linked to protein kinase activity, membrane transport and the glycan biosynthesis and metabolism pathway. We also identified 4005 differential alternative events in 2319 genes significantly regulated by cold stress. Exon skipping and intron retention were the most common alternative splicing isoforms. Numerous genes were identified that differentially modulated under cold stress, including cold-induced transcription factors and splicing factors mediated by AS (alternative splicing). GO enrichment analysis found that differentially alternatively spliced genes without differential expression levels were related to RNA/mRNA processing and spliceosomes. DAS (differentially alternative splicing) genes with different expression levels were mainly enriched in protein kinase activity, plasma membrane and cellular response to stimulus. We further identified and cloned DcCBP20 in D. catenatum; we found that DcCBP20 promotes the generation of alternative splicing variants in cold-induced genes under cold stress via genetic experiments and RT-PCR. Taken together, our results identify the main cold-response pathways and alternative splicing events in D. catenatum responding to cold treatment and that DcCBP20 of D. catenatum get involved in regulating the AS and gene expression of cold-induced genes during this process. Our study will contribute to understanding the role of AS genes in regulating the cold stress response in D. catenatum.
abstract_zh: 金钗石斛（Dendrobium catenatum Lindl）因其观赏价值和特殊药用价值，是一种珍贵的药材和园艺植物。低温是限制金钗石斛向北扩展的主要瓶颈，影响其品质和产量。本研究通过RNA-Seq分析了金钗石斛的冷响应。在冷胁迫下共检测到4302个差异表达基因，主要涉及蛋白激酶活性、膜运输以及聚糖生物合成和代谢途径。我们还鉴定了2319个基因中的4005个差异可变剪接事件，这些事件受冷胁迫显著调控。外显子跳跃和内含子保留是最常见的可变剪接异构体形式。许多基因在冷胁迫下表现出差异调控，包括由AS（可变剪接）介导的冷诱导转录因子和剪接因子。GO富集分析发现，无差异表达水平的差异可变剪接基因与RNA/mRNA加工和剪接体相关。具有不同表达水平的DAS（差异可变剪接）基因主要富集在蛋白激酶活性、质膜和细胞对刺激的响应中。我们进一步鉴定并克隆了金钗石斛中的DcCBP20；通过遗传实验和RT-PCR，我们发现DcCBP20在冷胁迫下促进冷诱导基因中可变剪接变体的产生。综合来看，我们的结果确定了金钗石斛响应冷处理的主要冷响应途径和可变剪接事件，并表明金钗石斛的DcCBP20在此过程中参与调控冷诱导基因的AS和基因表达。我们的研究将有助于理解AS基因在调控金钗石斛冷胁迫响应中的作用。
